name: GH Jenewein
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to GH Jenewein in Tirol**

Discover the charm of the **Tirol** at **GH Jenewein**, a historic hotel nestled in the heart of the Alps. Our elegant rooms and suites blend traditional Tyrolean warmth with modern comfort, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains.

Indulge in our renowned **Tiroler cuisine**, where every dish tells a story. Savor the fluffy layers of **Kaiserschmarrn**, melt in your mouth **Apfelstrudel**, or enjoy a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**—each bite is a celebration of regional flavors.

After a day of adventure—whether hiking in the **Zillertal**, skiing in **Ischgl**, or exploring the imperial city of **Innsbruck**—return to our cozy hotel for relaxation. Our wellness area invites you to unwind, while our wine cellar offers fine **Tiroler wines** to toast to your alpine escape.

Experience **Tirol** like never before at **GH Jenewein**, where tradition meets hospitality. **Willkommen in Tirol!**
